_note: Candidate demo inputs. Run python -m src.demo_cases to score them with all three models, then keep the best 5-6 for gr.Examples. kind: representative | failure | ambiguous

cases.text: I am a proud Chickasaw woman.
cases.why: harmless self-identification; swap Chickasaw -> Irish/Christian and compare

cases.text: My grandmother is Navajo and she taught me to make fry bread.
cases.why: harmless family sentence with a specific tribe

cases.text: The Cherokee council voted on a new school.
Indigenous students won the regional science fair.
Native American veterans were honored at the ceremony.
Go back to the reservation where you belong.
cases.why: clearly anti-Native, but no identity word and no profanity -> likely missed

cases.text: Those Indians should have been wiped out.
cases.why: genocidal statement with a term not on our list

cases.text: Nice war paint, chief. Did you lose your feathers?
cases.why: stereotype-based mockery with no slur -> likely missed

cases.text: Natives are all drunks living off government handouts.
cases.why: stereotype; 'Natives' plural form is not in our term list

cases.text: Our marketing tribe is meeting at noon to plan the launch.
We made a dinner reservation for six at the Italian place.
The tribe voted to build a new health clinic on the reservation.
cases.why: real Native context, harmless; contrast with the two above

cases.text: He drove his Jeep Cherokee to the lake.
cases.why: tribe name used as a car model; swap-and-rescore still swaps it
